reasoning.mutually_exclusive: effort and max_tokens cannot both be set
reasoning.live_detection: /api/v1/models returns supported_parameters; 'reasoning' or 'reasoning_effort' in list means model accepts the reasoning shape

web_search.default_engine: native for OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Perplexity/xAI, exa for others

quirks: :free routes require logging/training consent (privacy_optout NOT available)
Sending reasoning.max_tokens alongside reasoning.effort returns 400
Sending include_reasoning=true returns reasoning tokens in the response (extra output tokens billed)
openrouter.python_snippet:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url='https://openrouter.ai/api/v1', api_key=os.environ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY'])
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model='moonshotai/kimi-k3',
    messages=[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}],
    reasoning={'effort':'high'},  # optional: 'none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max'
    extra_body={'plugins':[{'id':'web'}]},  # optional: native web search
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

reasoning.live_detection: Per-model NIM reference page (https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/<slug>-infer) lists the canonical params + their enums. The 'Snippets translate this field into the model chat_template_kwargs' note means top-level reasoning_effort is the supported API; chat_template_kwargs is the underlying shape and also works.

quirks: Free tier: 40 RPM, 1000 RPD per model (captest-verified 2026-06)
NIM rate-limit 429s on rapid successive test calls — added num_retries=3 retry_after=5
deepseek-v4-pro 'max' effort thinks past every timeout (captest killed at 35min still thinking) — override per-request when truly needed
nemotron-3-ultra requires force_nonempty_content:true when combining tools+thinking
nemotron-3-ultra reasoning_budget is soft (closes at newline before budget or +500 tok)
GLM-5.1 captest-verified; NIM ref page 404s but the param shape works
Streaming via SSE: stream_options:{include_usage:true} returns token counts in the final chunk

reasoning.live_detection: Per-model CF docs page (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/<slug>/) lists reasoning_effort + chat_template_kwargs (both shown in schema, but only ONE is meaningful per model — see curated catalog).

quirks: max_tokens is DEPRECATED — use max_completion_tokens or thinking gets cut mid-trace (seen live)

Function calling tag in the model list page indicates tool support
Free tier: 10000 Neurons/day per account, shared across all models
cloudflare.python_snippet:
import httpx
client = httpx.Client(base_url='https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/'+account_id+'/ai', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token})
resp = client.post('/v1/chat/completions', json={
    'model':'@cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6',
    'messages':[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}],
    'reasoning_effort':'high',  # low|medium|high (kimi-k2.6 only; others use chat_template_kwargs:{enable_thinking:true})
    'max_completion_tokens':32768,  # NOT max_tokens (deprecated)
})
print(resp.json()['result']['response'])

reasoning.shape: none — GitHub Models uses standard Azure OpenAI params, no reasoning_effort
reasoning.behavior: Models tagged 'reasoning' in capabilities reason NATIVELY on every request (phi-4-reasoning, deepseek-r1, deepseek-r1-0528). No configurable effort knob.
reasoning.live_detection: https://models.github.ai/catalog/models returns capabilities:['reasoning', 'streaming', 'tool-calling'] per model. 'reasoning' tag = native reasoning (no param); 'tool-calling' tag = function-calling support.

quirks: phi-4-reasoning STRIPS custom system prompts (captest: in_tokens=233, never saw the input) — quirk folds system into the user message
deepseek-r1 reasons natively (no param) — already gets the thinking tokens
Rate limit: tier-based (free tier ~150 RPM, 4000 TPM for low-tier accounts)
Models are OpenAI-compatible — use OpenAI client with the GitHub Models base URL

opencode-zen.auth: OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY (free + paid; -free suffix models still paid on Zen)

reasoning.shape: UNKNOWN — Zen /v1/models returns only id+object+created+owned_by; no supported_parameters
reasoning.behavior: Zen is an OpenAI-compatible proxy. Underlying models (Claude, GPT-5.x, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi) accept their upstream reasoning params, but Zen does not document which ones it forwards. CONSERVATIVE: don't send reasoning params (a 400 blacklists the slot). Frontend hides the effort button for Zen models.
reasoning.live_detection: None — Zen's /v1/models does not expose supported_parameters. Curated catalog is empty for opencode-zen.

quirks: big-pickle is the only verified-free Zen model (rest require Zen credits even with -free suffix)
_ZEN_PAID_SUFFIX_EXCEPTIONS: minimax-m3-free, qwen3.6-plus-free — despite -free suffix these are PAID on Zen (only free via Go)
57 models total (Jun 2026): Claude (12), Gemini (6), GPT (16), Grok (2), DeepSeek (3), GLM (3), Minimax (3), Kimi (3), Qwen (2), misc (7)
Models are OpenAI-compatible — use OpenAI client with the Zen base URL
Reasoning params are NOT sent — Zen doesn't document forwarding, and a 400 blacklists the slot
